title: A medication listed twice is named twice in one dosing prompt
method: wizard drive with a repeated medication, then read the composed prompt
observed_at_discovery: Rehearsal printed: "Cura:  It's time for your Metformin and metformin." The setup wizard stores both entries verbatim and generate_medication_reminder names every entry in the slot with no de-duplication. A listener with late-stage dementia hears two drugs named and has no way to tell that it is one.
